avatar.description: Legacy text avatar. Use avatar_config for procedural agent identity.

tools.name: ngertiin.ask_user
tools.description: Ask the owner for necessary input, review or approval in DM or group, then end the turn. For approval, action must contain the exact product tool_name and its full arguments, and options must be null. Other questions must omit action. Plain text replies use the normal conversation; options use a compact inline card.

tools.name: ngertiin.group_ask_user
tools.description: Ask for input needed by the current group task and retain its existing continuation owner. A temporary question or wait alone does not require a Goal. End this turn after asking.
